entries.name: SmishX
entries.license_verification: verified from LICENSE at the recorded commit
entries.model_provenance: No model asset is bundled. The inspected source calls an externally configured OpenAI model.
entries.local_changes: Implemented a new text-only structured-output adapter informed by the reviewed category guidance. No upstream runtime code was copied. The adapter separates legitimate, spam, suspected_scam, and unknown; validates literal evidence quotes; maps missing configuration, provider failures, invalid JSON, and deadlines to explicit unavailable states; records model and prompt versions; never dereferences URLs; and writes no output files.
verification_notes: The inspected source combines phishing and spam into a boolean category.
The final detection exception returns category true.
URL expansion is called before optional URL checks and therefore still dereferences input in the inspected fast path.
The local adapter does not use the upstream URL, crawling, screenshot, search, WHOIS, or output-file paths.
Provider categories and evidence are schema validated; evidence quotes must be exact substrings of the submitted text.

entries.name: phishing-url-detector
entries.license_verification: verified from LICENSE and pyproject.toml at the recorded commit
entries.model_provenance: Reviewed plain JSON parameters for a StandardScaler plus logistic regression trained from UCI PhiUSIIL dataset #967 (CC BY 4.0), with documented synthetic legitimate deep-link augmentation. The upstream joblib model and source dataset are not copied. The upstream reported metrics are not Fraudster performance claims.
entries.local_changes: The JSON model path is adapted for the isolated URL service. The adapter loads it once, validates exact feature order, and maps string-only classification to the private gateway ModuleResult contract without WHOIS, DNS, HTTP fetches, or the upstream CLI/browser.
verification_notes: The runtime feature order is validated against the JSON model metadata.
The upstream 0-100 heuristic score and blended band are policy values, not a calibrated fraud probability.
The upstream Safe label must not be presented as a guarantee.

entries.name: PaddleOCR
entries.license_verification: Apache-2.0 LICENSE in installed paddleocr 2.9.1 distribution
entries.model_provenance: Optional upstream en_PP-OCRv3_det_infer, en_PP-OCRv4_rec_infer and ch_ppocr_mobile_v2.0_cls_infer weights referenced by PaddleOCR 2.9.1. Explicit setup downloads to ignored services/ocr/models; no weights redistributed in Git.
entries.local_changes: Original CPU adapter/setup. Hash-verified upstream wheel repackaged locally with build tag 1fraudster: OpenCV dependency metadata replaced with headless-only; implementation bytes unchanged. Local wheels/models are temporary or ignored, never redistributed in Git.
verification_notes: English recognition only in this configuration; PaddlePaddle CPU 2.6.2 and numpy 1.26.4 pinned.
Service checks prepared files before constructing PaddleOCR; missing assets/dependencies are unavailable, never downloaded during requests.
